title: user.transcript
description: Words from the caller as the recognizer hears them. Interim while final is false; the final one becomes turn.user. Interim entries are ephemeral.

UserTranscript.description: Words from the caller as the recognizer hears them. Interim while final is false; the final one becomes turn.user. Interim entries are ephemeral.

text.description: The transcript so far, or the final one.

final.description: True when the recognizer will not revise this.

language.description: The language heard, as a BCP 47 tag.

confidence.description: The recognizer's confidence, 0 to 1, when it reports one.
